subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt and refresh https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544 for this Control UI resolver fix, or close that fork PR and request a fresh current-main PR?
rationale: The issue remains source-reproducible, but an open linked PR with closing syntax already owns the implementation lane and should be handled before another automated fix job starts.

options.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
options.body: Use the existing focused implementation if maintainers can refresh it to current paths, verify behavior, and resolve stale checks.

options.title: Request a fresh replacement
options.body: Close or leave the fork PR aside and ask for a current-main UI-only resolver PR with focused regression proof.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused implementation if maintainers can refresh it to current paths, verify behavior, and resolve stale checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the channel UI metadata and gateway catalog path that steipete centralized.
